name: List Custom Objects
summary: Lists every custom object type in your instance (up to 10 types) with its key fields and relationships to leads.
whenToUse: The starting point for custom objects — find the object's API name before describing, querying, or syncing it.

response.description: One entry per object type: name, idField, dedupeFields, searchableFields, and relationships (e.g. which lead field links to it).

notes: Custom objects store extra per-lead data (e.g. cars owned, courses taken) beyond the standard lead fields.
The dedupeFields value (e.g. vin) is what you'll use to match records in Sync/Delete calls.
